title: Mooshroom Energy
body:
🍄 Mooshroom Energy

Fuel your adventures with moo-tastic power!




--- ## 🌟 Introduction A survival-focused datapack that transforms underused Minecraft items into powerful consumables. Features **4 energy drinks** and **3 tiered snacks** with unique buffs, all using custom player head textures by [Lyera](https://x.com/LyeraMC) (*no resource pack required*). 🔗 **Synergy:** Compatible with **[Food Balance](https://modrinth.com/datapack/food-balance)** and **[Apple Enchant](https://modrinth.com/datapack/apple-enchant)** for expanded food mechanics! --- ## 🧉 Mooshroom Energy Drinks *5-minute duration effects | Crafted with Cocoa Beans + Iron Ingot + Unique Ingredients*

### 🍀 Classic Mooshroom Energy
**Recipe:** Honey Bottle + Sea Pickle **Effects:** - Haste II ⛏️ - Luck 🍀 ### ❄️ Absolute Zero Edition
**Recipe:** Blue Ice + Breeze Rod **Effects:** - Wind Charged (particle effects) 🌪️ - Dolphin’s Grace 🐬 - Fire Resistance 🔥 ### 💖 Pink Edition
**Recipe:** Beetroot Soup + Sugar **Effects:** - Regeneration ❤️🩹 ### ⚪ Zero Sugar Edition
**Recipe:** Resin Clump + Water Bottle/Potion **Effects:** - Night Vision 🌙👁️ --- ## 🍴 Mooshroom Snacks ### 🍔 Big Moosh Burger
**Recipe:** Bread + any Grass + any chicken Egg + Cooked Meat **Effects:** - Saturation 🍗 - Extra Hearts 💝 with a slight chance ### 🍟 MooshDonalds Meal
**Recipe:** Cake + Baked Potato + 2x any Cooked Meat **Effects:** - Max Saturation 🍗🍗 - 2 Shield Hearts 💛💛 - Strength 💪 with a slight chance - Resistance 🛡️ with a slight chance ### 👑 Grand Big Moosh (Ultimate Tier)
**Recipe:** Bread + *Tall Grass* + any rare Egg (sniffer, turtle or dragon) + Enchanted Golden Apple **Effects:** - Saturation 🍗 - 10 Shield Hearts 💛×10 - Decaying Resistance 🛡️100%→0% **Note:** Tall Grass is actually a rare item which is only obtained from chest loot, it deserves more love! --- ## 🔑 Key Features - **Revitalized Items:** Gives purpose to Sea Pickles, Beetroot Soup, Tall Grass, and Breeze Rods. - **Balanced Tiers:** Combines common (e.g., Sugar) and rare (e.g., Blue Ice) ingredients. - **Anti-Clutter Mechanic:** Reduces block range when holding items to prevent misplacement. - **Survival & RP Ready:** Perfect for hardcore worlds or themed servers. --- ## ⚖️ Legal Disclaimer *This fan-made datapack is not affiliated with or endorsed by:* - Monster Energy® (energy drink brand) - McDonald's® (fast-food chain) *All assets are original creations inspired by Minecraft’s art style. "Mooshroom Energy" and "MooshDonalds" are fictional names for in-game use only.* --- ## 📜 License **All Rights Reserved** ✅ **You are free to:** - Add this datapack to your modpacks (provided you use the **Modrinth download link**). - Share the official Modrinth page with others. - Modify the code strictly for **personal use**. ❌ **Without explicit permission, you CANNOT:** - Reupload this datapack or its files anywhere else. - Use the code, assets, or mechanics in other public projects.
